_comment: Each step of the provider notices kit, with the NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls whose statements it supports and the FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicators whose 'Related SP 800-53 Controls' cite them. Control text read from NIST's OSCAL catalog (release 5.2.0) and the KSIs from fedramp.gov's 2026 KSI pages on November 9, 2026; SA-9 to KSI-SCR-MIT and KSI-SCR-MON, CM-3 to KSI-CMT-LMC and CA-7 to KSI-MLA-EVC are also Book 13, Appendix A's rows, and AU-9 to KSI-MLA-OSM is the privileged access guide's. KSIs are FedRAMP's indicators for cloud service providers: the agency lines its own evidence up with what its providers report against them and doesn't report KSIs itself. Which step supports which control is the program's reading (design guidance); the agency's assessor decides. 'stages' lists the steps each stage's evidence must hold before the go/no-go (deploy/Test-PnEvidence.ps1).

SA-9.title: External System Services
SA-9.part: c. monitor control compliance by external service providers on an ongoing basis

SI-5.title: Security Alerts, Advisories, and Directives
SI-5.part: a. receive alerts and advisories from external organizations on an ongoing basis; c. disseminate them; d. implement directives in the established time frames

CM-3.title: Configuration Change Control
CM-3.part: b. review proposed changes with security and privacy impact analysis; f. monitor and review activities associated with configuration-controlled changes

CM-4.title: Impact Analyses
CM-4.part: analyze changes to determine potential security and privacy impacts before implementation

CP-2.title: Contingency Plan
CP-2.part: e. update the plan to address changes to the organization, system or environment of operation

SR-8.title: Notification Agreements
SR-8.part: establish agreements and procedures with entities in the supply chain for notification

RA-3.title: Risk Assessment
RA-3.part: f. update the risk assessment when there are significant changes to the system or its environment of operation

CA-7.title: Continuous Monitoring
CA-7.part: d. ongoing monitoring; e. correlation and analysis; f. response actions

AU-9.title: Protection of Audit Information
AU-9.part: protect audit information from unauthorized modification

ksis.KSI-SCR-MON: Monitoring Supply Chain Risk (cites SA-9, SI-5, SR-8, RA-3)
ksis.KSI-SCR-MIT: Mitigating Supply Chain Risk (cites SA-9, RA-3)
ksis.KSI-MLA-OSM: Operating SIEM Capability (the privileged access guide's mapping for AU-9)

COL-M365.title: Collect Microsoft 365 Message center posts and service health issues

COL-GOOGLE.title: Collect Google Cloud Personalized Service Health events

NORMALIZE.title: Normalize every notice into one record

ROUTE.title: Route notices that need action to an owner as a task

CONTINGENCY.title: Flag retirements and maintenance for a contingency plan review

EVIDENCE.title: Record the run as hashed, chained evidence

PRE.title: Preflight: settings, tools, signed-in clouds and notification agreements

ALERTS.title: Plan Azure Service Health alerts at scale with Azure Policy
